person_note: The novel has sustained base narration in two persons: Troy Phelan narrates chapters 1–2 in first person, then his death ends that voice and chapter 3 begins the sustained third-person narrative that controls the remainder. The Goodreads quotations sample only the later Nate-centered portion; its longer event passages independently corroborate that third-person phase, while dialogue and generic “you” statements are non-diagnostic. The authorized multi-chapter excerpt, scholarly structural analysis, and two explicit secondary descriptions agree, leaving no material structural conflict; the quote sample’s omission of the opening is the main coverage limitation.
